minutes.summary: Held remotely during COVID-19, the committee approved prior minutes, then reviewed the job description for a new principal assessor position, now largely outsourced. what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee voted unanimously by roll call to accept a job description for a new principal assessor position.
The committee voted unanimously to place the principal assessor position in pay grade 15, citing pay comparisons with nearby towns.
Weekly hours on the job description were corrected from 36 to 40; the reporting line is to be confirmed with town counsel.
The position is to be posted while a request for proposals to outsource the duties goes out, then the better route chosen.
A town meeting vote is still needed to add the position to the grid, with funds available July 1st.

why_it_matters: The assessor's work sets how property values are determined for tax bills, and the choice between a town employee and an outside contractor decides how that cost is carried in the budget.
Residents may be asked to vote at a special Town Meeting to add the position to the pay grid.

Town counsel's confirmation of the reporting line, and the comparison of the posting against the outsourcing proposals.
